### Repent, Rescue, Repeat
Author: Wendy Pope
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-aug-26-2009-11607722.html
Passage: Judges 10:6a
Points:
- Difficult circumstances often tempt believers to fall back into old, familiar sin patterns.
- Persistent idolatry and disobedience ultimately produce exhausting misery that grieves God's heart.
- Pleading for relief without true surrender is merely lip service aimed at escaping trouble.
- Genuine biblical repentance requires a complete turnabout and allowing God to transform the heart.
